      "snippet": "You’re right: what we had was “cool toy,” not “teaching engine.” I’ve pushed it a level up.
Here’s what I changed and the new file.

🚀 What’s upgraded
1. Subitizing – now with arrays + tracking + goal

Ten-frame now shows as a 2×5 array, not a single line.

Each flash still randomizes a pattern, but now you get:

Answer box (“I saw: __”) ➜ Check button (already there).

Session stats:

Correct: x / y (z%) • Streak: n

Clear kid-facing goal text + EN/ES read-aloud:

“Train your math eyes. See how"
